analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction that they were not told of an interest rate cut on their savings account and claims about £43.20 financial loss (CH-1).
analysis.summary: Customer says the interest rate on their Harbourline Easy Saver fell from 3.1% to 1.6% in July 2026 and they received no letter or email about it. They say they would have moved their money had they known, and estimate lost interest of £43.20 which they want refunded. Internal note shows the rate change notice batch 06/2026 was sent by email, the customer's email bounced, and no letter fallback was sent. No vulnerability indicators recorded. First contact.

timeline.event: Interest rate on Harbourline Easy Saver reduced from 3.1% to 1.6%
Customer did not receive a letter or email about the rate change
Rate change notice batch 06/2026 sent; customer's email bounced; no letter fallback sent
Complaint received via web form and logged

analysis.severity_reason: Customer-estimated financial loss of £43.20 is under £100 (CH-6). No indication of repeated contact, staff conduct, fraud or vulnerability.

vulnerability.suggested_support: None indicated by the case file. Confirm contact preference and any reasonable adjustments at first contact.

analysis.routing_reason: Service and communication issue with a low estimated loss. None of the ESC-1 triggers apply, so the complaints handler can resolve it.
